android-specialized|File and photo picke.summary: A Plenix image upload on Android opens the system photo picker (PickVisualMedia) or the document picker (OpenDocument) from a Plenix outlined button and shows the chosen picture in a frame of a fixed ratio with the media radius and the thin default border, its name in DM Mono, and Replace and Remove beside it; a profile picture is the Plenix avatar (a rounded square, never a circle) with Change photo and Remove photo. The system picker stays as Android draws it; Plenix styles the control that opens it and what shows after.

variants.name: Single (default)
variants.compose: rememberLauncherForActivityResult(PickVisualMedia()) launched from an OutlinedButton; the picture in a framed preview
variants.use: One picture: a cover or a header image.

variants.name: Multiple
variants.compose: PickMultipleVisualMedia(max) and a LazyVerticalGrid of square previews

variants.name: Avatar
variants.material: Photo picker for a profile picture
